description: Change a form's name (1–120 characters). The name is what the dashboard and the responses grid show; it does not change the form's id, hosted slug, or published schema, so live embeds keep working. Needs forms:write.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_rename_form
title: Rename a form
